character.name: Ozra Duskmaw
character.background: Warlock (fire pact) / comet-born ash witch marked by an ancient fire spirit

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: A bead of comet-touched fire streaks from Ozra's fingers and can ignite dry cloth, old parchment, or traitorous lies.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A lash of ash-white force crackles from Ozra's palm, carrying the voice of the fire spirit in its snap.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: A thin fan of flame bursts from Ozra's thumbs, hot enough to turn bone to chalk and memory to smoke.

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.description: When harmed, Ozra answers with a snap of retributive hellfire that coils around the attacker like a burning debt.

traits: Ashborn Darkvision: Ozra sees in dim light as bright light and in darkness as grayscale up to 60 ft.
Hellish Resistance: Ozra has resistance to fire damage.
Ember Pact: Ozra regains one pact spell slot after a short rest.
Comet-Frightened: when she is afraid, her hair smolders and nearby candles flare, making concealment difficult.
character.gear: Emberwood staff · ashen leather coat · comet-cured rations ×3 · emberleaf healing draught · cinder-bound grimoire · bone tinderbox · hempen rope
character.story: Ozra was born while the Ash-Star bled embers over the salt wastes. Her mother held her over a cold hearth and whispered a bargain meant to save a dying child. The fire answered, leaving a cinder-sigil beneath Ozra’s tongue. Now every spark leans toward her, hungry for orders she fears to give. She follows the smell of smoke to ruined shrines, asking old flames what they remember. The pactbook she carries is signed in her mother’s hand, not hers. Ozra does not know whether the spirit chose her, or merely bought her.

inventory.name: Emberwood Staff
inventory.lore: Cut from a lightning-struck ash-tree in the burnt orchard of Vhul-Mor, its grain still smells of the comet. Ozra’s mother wrapped the grip in widow's leather to stop it from smoking.
inventory.description: A blackened quarterstaff that sheds warm motes when it is angry.

inventory.name: Ashen Leather Coat
inventory.lore: Stitched from the hide of a smoke-elk that walked out of the Cinder Court's pyre. It was meant to be Ozra’s first-birthday coat, but it never stopped smelling of burnt milk.
inventory.description: A soot-dark leather coat lined with quilted ashcloth.

inventory.name: Comet-Cured Rations
inventory.lore: Dried over the last warm night before the ash rains, these strips were blessed by the hearth-priests of the Mourning Kiln. They taste of iron and old prayer.
inventory.description: Three comet-cured sausage strips wrapped in waxed cloth.

inventory.name: Emberleaf Healing Draught
inventory.lore: Distilled from emberleaf that grows only where the comet’s tail touched the ground. Ozra’s mother traded three years of warmth for the recipe.
inventory.description: A copper-stoppered vial of glowing amber liquid.

inventory.name: Cinder-Bound Grimoire
inventory.lore: Its pages are thin bark pressed from the Ashfall grove, and the first page bears a signature that is not Ozra’s. The ink glows when someone nearby tells a lie about fire.
inventory.description: A thin bark-bound book whose pages resist burning.
inventory.effects: Can be used as a spellcasting focus for Ozra’s pact spells.

inventory.name: Bone Tinderbox
inventory.lore: Carved from the jawbone of a hearth-wyrm that died before the comet came. It strikes flame even in damp ruins, though the flame is always grey.
inventory.description: A small bone box holding char-cloth and flint.
inventory.effects: Can start a fire in 1 action, even in damp conditions.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope
inventory.lore: Braided by ash-widows in the rope-pits of Vhul-Mor, each strand knotted with a name lost to the fire. It is stronger than it should be.
inventory.description: Fifty feet of grey hempen rope.
